An old dwarf explorer, {npc:Junkar}, discovered a steamship route along underground rivers between Thais and Kazordoon. If the server hands him 200 {item:Coal|Coals}, the boat starts running from the next server save and you can travel (one way only) from Thais to Kazordoon and, depending on the state of the Awash world change, to Robson's Isle.

The best sources of {item:Coal} are {creature:Firestarter|Firestarters} (low health, they spawn in large numbers and have some of the best drop rates), {creature:The Lost} and {creature:Stonerefiner|Stonerefiners} (great for large amounts, but they are packed close together and deal a lot of damage at low levels).
Junkar doesn't say when he has enough coal. Put a friend next to a {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} asking about {key:steamship} while you hand in the coal bit by bit.
Don't confuse it with the {wiki:Awash|Awash} world change: there you hand in coal in Kazordoon to pump out the water of the {wiki:Sunken Mines|Sunken Mines}.

Gather {item:Coal}. A total of **200** is needed for the whole server, but this world change is not very popular, so expect to do it alone. Hunt {creature:Firestarter|Firestarters}, {creature:The Lost} or {creature:Stonerefiner|Stonerefiners}.
Stonerefiners are packed close together and can deal a lot of damage to low-level players.
Leave **Thais** to the **north** and go into the {wiki:Ancient Temple|Ancient Temple} entrance.
Go down the stairs **two floors**. Instead of heading north towards the temple, go **south** and a little to the **east**. These stairs lead down to {npc:Junkar}'s room and his steamship.

Hand in the Coal to Junkar
Say {key:hi} and {key:coal} to {npc:Junkar} and agree to donate the coal with {key:yes}. Hand it in bit by bit.
Junkar accepts coal even when he already has enough, so don't hand in everything at once if you have someone checking the status.
Check the status with a Guide NPC

There is no visual sign and Junkar doesn't say whether it's enough. Ask a {wiki:Guide NPCs|Guide NPC} about {key:steamship} (for example {npc:Guide Luke}, in Thais). To leave Junkar's room without using the ship, go back up the same stairs to the Ancient Temple entrance floor and leave to the **south**, towards Thais.
That's enough: wait for the server save.

After the next server save the service starts. Talk to {npc:Junkar}: {key:hi}, {key:passage} and choose {key:Kazordoon}. The trip is **one-way only**. Depending on the state of the Awash world change, you may also be able to travel to Robson's Isle (Junkar mentions the {key:mines}, which are only accessible when they are clear). Since there is no return trip by ship, to get back from Kazordoon use other transport (for example the {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} on top of the Kazordoon mountain, at {coord:32587,31941,0}: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; or on foot, over the mountain).
Trip from Thais to Kazordoon until the next server save
The effect lasts only until the next server save after it has started.
If you ask Junkar about {key:beasts}, he mentions carrion worms and cyclopes as creatures that also carry coal.
